arguments.sql:
SELECT s.DOC, s.DOCType, COUNT(*) AS rows_in_group, COUNT(DISTINCT s.CDSCode) AS codes, COUNT(s.School) AS named_schools, COUNT(t.cds) AS matched, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT t.rtype) AS record_types, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT typeof(t.NumTstTakr)) AS count_types, SUM(t.NumTstTakr) AS test_takers
FROM main.schools AS s
LEFT JOIN main.satscores AS t ON t.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Los Angeles' AND s.OpenDate >= '2007-01-01' AND s.OpenDate < '2008-01-01'
GROUP BY s.DOC, s.DOCType

  AND s.OpenDate >= '2007-01-01'
  AND s.OpenDate < '2008-01-01'
